description: Search FDA medical-device recall records by firm, product, product code, K number, status, or date. A recall record describes a correction/removal action and does not by itself establish patient harm. Pass `classification` ("Class I", "Class II" or "Class III" -- FDA's risk class of the recall) to search FDA's recall ENFORCEMENT reports instead, which carry the class: `from_date`/`to_date` then filter the report date, `total` is the full match count (not just the page returned), and `product_code`/`k_number` are refused because enforcement reports do not carry them. Without `classification` the plain recall-action records are searched, which have no class. Unknown arguments are rejected, not ignored.

classification.description: FDA recall class: "Class I" (most serious), "Class II" or "Class III" (also "I"/"II"/"III"/1/2/3). Switches the search to FDA enforcement reports; see tool description.

from_date.description: Earliest posted date, YYYY-MM-DD (report date when `classification` is set).

status.description: Recall status, e.g. Ongoing or Terminated.

to_date.description: Latest date, YYYY-MM-DD. Only with `classification` (enforcement report date); refused otherwise.

name: fda_device_recalls
title: Fda Device Recalls
